scripts.start: bun run validate-env && NODE_ENV=production bun src/index.ts
scripts.build: bun run validate-env && bun run build.ts
scripts.populate: bun run validate-env && bun run src/lib/db/DBS_populator.ts
scripts.scrape: bun run validate-env && python -m venv .venv && ./.venv/Scripts/pip install pipreqs && ./.venv/Scripts/pipreqs ./scraper --force && ./.venv/Scripts/pip install -r scraper/requirements.txt && ./.venv/Scripts/python ./scraper/fetch_data.py
